context: A boss welcomes a new hire on his first day at the office
purpose: Teach: 小売/通販/入社/デバイス/インテリア/店内/応答/受け取っ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 入社おめでとう。今日から我が社の一員だ。緊張しているかね？
lines.en: Welcome aboard. From today you're part of our company. Are you nervous?
lines.style: Warm but authoritative tone, measured pace, welcoming yet professional senior executive voice

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、少し。御社が小売と通販の両方を扱っていると聞いて、勉強してきました。
lines.en: Yes, a little. I heard your company handles both retail and online shopping, so I studied up.
lines.style: Polite eager fresh-graduate energy, slightly nervous but enthusiastic and respectful

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 感心だな。まずこのデバイスを受け取ってくれ。社員証と業務用タブレットだ。
lines.en: Impressive. First, take this device. It's your employee ID and work tablet.
lines.style: Brisk practical instruction, slight pride in the equipment, paternal mentoring quality

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。確かに受け取っております。大切に使わせていただきます。
lines.en: Thank you very much. I've received it. I'll use it carefully.
lines.style: Formal grateful acceptance, slight bow conveyed in voice, respectful junior register

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 君には店内のインテリア担当チームに入ってもらう予定だ。お客様の動線が鍵でね。
lines.en: I plan to assign you to the in-store interior team. Customer flow is key, you see.
lines.style: Confident strategic delivery, briefly explanatory, leader sharing the vision with new recruit

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: インテリアの仕事ですか。動線設計も含めて、一から学ばせてください。
lines.en: Interior work? Including flow design, please let me learn everything from scratch.
lines.style: Earnest curious follow-up, humble learning attitude, voice rising with genuine interest

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うん、いい返事だ。問い合わせへの応答も現場で覚えていけばいい。期待しているよ。
lines.en: Good, nice reply. You can learn how to respond to inquiries on the floor too. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Encouraging conclusion, warm chuckle underneath, sincere boss approval and motivation
